name: Being silenced keeps the Witch Doctor's second ingredient (#13071)
contract: #13071 (Witch Doctor) reports that being silenced removes the second Cauldron ingredient, such as
Bloodthistle 801664, while the first ingredient, Jungle Shrooms 801660, stays. Mixologist 561069 tooltips
that you can add an additional ingredient to your Cauldron. The ingredients are permanent self auras
(SpellDuration 21 after the class contract) with no AuraInterruptFlags and no dispel type, so nothing in
Spell.dbc ties them to a silence. Expected: with Cauldron Brewer 92085 and Mixologist, brewing Jungle
Shrooms then Bloodthistle keeps both, and a Silence (15487, 5 sec) neither removes either ingredient while
it lasts nor after it ends. Bloodthistle is a periodic trigger aura that brews its Cauldron tick 802771
every 1.5 sec, and 802771 has PreventionType 1 (silence) in Spell.dbc. While the Witch Doctor was silenced
the tick failed its cast check, and the native rule for non-passive periodic auras on players ended
Bloodthistle (it expired right after the silence). Jungle Shrooms' tick 802703 has no prevention type, and
Fish Oil and Frog Bones are plain dummy auras, so they survived. The Witch Doctor contract clears the
prevention type of the Bloodthistle tick. A second Witch Doctor brews the same pair and is never silenced,
as a control. The silence is applied directly as an aura: a mob's cast of it can miss or be resisted, and
the tick fails the same way whoever applies the silence.
